spells.name: Comet Spear
spells.description: Tap: Pantheon thrusts his spear, dealing physical damage to enemies hit. Refunds % of this Ability's Cooldown. Hold: Pantheon hurls his spear, dealing physical damage to the first enemy hit and % less to further targets. This Ability is enhanced against enemies below % Health to deal physical damage instead. Mortal Will Bonus: Deals an additional physical damage.

spells.name: Grand Starfall
spells.description: Passive: Pantheon gains % Armor Penetration. Active: Pantheon gathers his strength to leap high into the air. He throws his spear from above which in a small area deals physical damage and Slows by % for seconds. Pantheon then crashes down as a meteor at the target area. Deals up to magic damage to enemies in a line (decreased by up to % at the edges of the area). This Ability instantly readies Mortal Will.
